starting-off.speaker: Veos
starting-off.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Where am I exactly?
Can you take me back to Port Sarim please?
Have you got any quests for me?

steps.player: Have you got any quests for me?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: As a matter of fact, [player name], I do...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I have a client from the mainland interested in some more knowledge surrounding the houses of Kourend. Do you think you'd be able to retrieve it for me?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I was just going to do it myself but as you're quite new around here, this might be a good opportunity for you to get to know the kingdom a bit better.

options.text: Sounds interesting! How can I help?

steps.player: Sounds interesting! How can I help?

steps.text: Veos hands you an enchanted scroll.
Player receives an enchanted scroll.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Take this scroll.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend; how it differs from the mainland, per se.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: That scroll is special. When written on with a particular type of quill, my client will see what you're writing without anything being seen on the scroll itself.

steps.player: Wait, wait! I'm not spying for somebody am I?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Not exactly... My client simply wishes to keep his 'knowledge gathering' on the down low before he makes his appearance.

steps.player: That seems fair. Who should I speak to in order to find out more about the houses?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: There's many a man and woman who could give you the information you need, but General store owners in house will likely be your best bet. They should know enough about their houses, and always seem up

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: for a chat.

steps.player: Good call. What about this special quill you mentioned?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Simply touching a normal feather onto the paper should synchronise their magical ability to work together. You don't need any ink.

steps.player: Right, I'll return to you when I have the information your client needs.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: See you soon.

options.text: I'm busy at the moment, actually. Not now.

steps.player: I'm busy at the moment, actually. Not now.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Very well. Do come back if you wish to help out my client.

starting-off-using-feather-on-enchanted-.text: You attune the feather to the enchanted scroll, creating an enchanted quill.

regath-the-arceuus-general-store-owner.speaker: Regath
regath-the-arceuus-general-store-owner.text: What do you require, traveller? I deal in many things.

options.text: Let's see what you've got.
Who are you?
I don't need anything.
Can I ask you about the Arceuus house?

steps.player: Can I ask you about the Arceuus house?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: This house holds knowledge many would deem unsafe to share. Why should I be so trusting to you?

steps.player: Well, I'm a...
Uhm...
A journalist! Yes, a journalist from the mainland. I want to let the wider world know of how this incredible house works.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Someone willing to share knowledge of our great house to many others?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Very well, then. The rest of the world could certainly do with learning about our great library.

options.text: What is it that Arceuus provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: So what exactly is it the Arceuus house brings to Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: The Arceuus house is filled with literary and magical scholars. Lead by the great Trobin Arceuus, as a leader, he assists in pushing the limit of our knowledge surrounding magical abilities, religion and the crafting of

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: runic energy. He cares not for petty control, focusing instead on the expansion of knowledge within Great Kourend.

options.text: How do people start gaining favour in Arceuus?

steps.player: How do people start gaining favour in Arceuus?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Those seeking favour within our household start with a particularly labour intensive job.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Our library, as grand as it is, still requires maintenance... constantly.

options.text: Why should I gain favour in Arceuus?

steps.player: Why should I gain favour in Arceuus?

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Our great library filled with millennia of knowledge; runic, magical and religious, are but small findings compared to the power of the Dark Altar.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Reanimation of life... that's where our studies currently lie. This knowledge could be yours.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: What is the matter, journalist?

steps.player: I... I don't know.
I must have caught my finger with the quill. Apologies; please continue.

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: Very well. As mentioned, rewards for loyalty within our household are priceless. The sharing of our research surrounding re-animation and magic is but child's play to the knowledge we share to the most loyal of our

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: house; the knowledge of Blood and Soul runecrafting.
If Regath was not the last general store owner you talked to:
If Regath was the last general store owner you talked to:

steps.player: Thanks for your help, Regath!

steps.speaker: Regath
steps.text: You're welcome. Spread the word of this great house with the new knowledge you have gained, and perhaps be more careful with how you hold your scroll in the future...

horace-the-hosidius-general-store-owner.speaker: Horace
horace-the-hosidius-general-store-owner.text: Welcome to my shop. Would you like to buy or sell something?

options.text: Who are you?
Okay, let's trade
No, I'm fine.
Can I ask you about the Hosidius house?

steps.player: Can I ask you about the Hosidius house?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Well, well my friend! I've lived in this great and glorious house all of my life. I'd be happy to share with you anything you'd like to know!

options.text: What is it that Hosidius provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: What is it that Hosidius provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: The Hosidius house is filled with keen and skilled farmers alike! Lead by the incredibly efficient Kandur Hosidius, his intelligent resourcefulness ensures optimal agricultural production.

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Our fields stretch as far as the eye can see. With incredible teamwork and group efforts, the ability to provide the majority of Great Kourend's people with both food and herbal supplies is quite literally the fruits

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: of our labour.

options.text: How do people start gaining favour in Hosidius?

steps.player: How do people start gaining favour in Hosidius?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Not into your back-breaking field maintenance or fertiliser creation? Those wishing to gain favour within our city may need to maintain such tediousness for a small while, though stick to it. The rewards for

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: that painful work are nothing short of great!

options.text: Why should I gain favour in Hosidius?

steps.player: Why should I gain favour with Hosidius?

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Access to our personal kitchens, Spirit Tree patch and Allotment space is lovely. That being said, our vinery and Tithe farm are world class and exclusive to only the most loyal of our house.
If Horace was not the last general store owner you talked to:
If Horace was the last general store owner you talked to:

steps.player: Thanks for your help, Horace!

steps.speaker: Horace
steps.text: Anytime, friend! Feel free to pop along if you ever need any wares!

options.text: Who are you?
Let's trade.
No, I'm fine.
Can I ask you about the Lovakengj house?

steps.player: Can I ask you about the Lovakengj house?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Why I'd be happy to have a chat! I do enjoy talking about this great house of ours.

options.text: What is it that Lovakengj provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: What is it that Lovakengj provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: The Lovakengj house is filled with incredibly skilled blacksmiths. Lead by Vulcana Lovakengj, her incredible leadership and intelligent material saving skills pave the way for future blacksmiths.

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Armours, weaponry, tools and structures - our house supplies Kourend with all of these to the finest standards known to Dwarf and Human alike.

options.text: How do people start gaining favour in Lovakengj?

steps.player: How do people start gaining favour in Lovakengj?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Those seeking favour within our household start with a dirty job.

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Creating dynamite and mining in the sulphur mine isn't a pretty job, but someone has to do it!

options.text: Why should I gain favour in Lovakengj?

steps.player: Why should I gain favour with Lovakengj?

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Those who endure our daunting introductory tasks are rewarded greatly - being taught to create the armour worn by the very soldiers of the Shayzien army, along with access to our Blast Mine - the rewards able to be

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: reaped by the most loyal of our house are nothing to be scoffed at!
If Munty was the last general store owner you talked to:
If Munty was the last general store owner you talked to:

steps.player: Thanks for your help, Munty!

steps.speaker: Munty
steps.text: Anytime! Come back soon!

leenz-the-port-piscarilius-general-store.speaker: Leenz
leenz-the-port-piscarilius-general-store.text: A great adventurer, from afar? How may I help with my repertoire?

options.text: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
Can I ask you about the Piscarilius house?

steps.player: Can I ask you about the Piscarilius house?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: If it's Piscarilius information you seek, it's in my brain that you must peek!

options.text: What is it that Piscarilius provides for Kourend?

steps.player: You're certainly a chirpy woman! What is it that Piscarilius house provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Within the Piscarilius house, you'll find, great fisherman, traders, pirates and I. All lead, by our ruthless leader, Shauna Piscarilius, none yet to supersede her.

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: No surprise if you meet her, her tactics are ruthless. Her demeanour renders, all pirates toothless.

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Our great shore and trading, have treasures to be found, providing export and fish, in quantities abound.

options.text: How do people start gaining favour in Piscarilius?

steps.player: How do people start gaining favour in Port Piscarilius?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Repairing net cranes, and gathering bait, newcomers to the port, well this is their fate... It's labour intensive, and dirty work, though stick to it friend, 'till your arms are inert.

options.text: Why should I gain favour in Piscarilius?

steps.player: Why should I gain favour in Piscarilius?

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Our shore is brimming, with gold from the sea, the most loyal of our people, are handed the key. We'll let you stand on our shores and collect, the great anglerfish; other houses... covet?
If Leenz was not the last general store owner you talked to:
If Leenz was the last general store owner you talked to:

steps.player: Hang on a second... that last one didn't rhyme too well!

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Listen here pal, you don't mess with people in Piscarilius. Do you want happy rhyming Leenz, or angry, gruff and pain-inflicting Leenz?

steps.player: Happy rhyming Leenz, please! Thanks for your help!

steps.speaker: Leenz
steps.text: Anytime, my adventuring friend, enjoy your time in Great Kourend!

jennifer-the-shayzien-general-store-owne.speaker: Jennifer
jennifer-the-shayzien-general-store-owne.text: What're yer looking for, me luv'?

options.text: Let's trade.
I don't need anything right now.
Can I ask you about the Shayzien house?

steps.player: Can I ask you about the Shayzien house?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Well I could give you some info if that's all yer wantin'. Gets lonely in 'ere while me mates are out there fightin' the good war!

options.text: What is it that Shayzien provides for Great Kourend?

steps.player: What is it that Shayzien provides for Great Kourend?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Phwoar, what don' we do? This 'ouse is filled with officers and the like. Lead by our rig'rous leader Shiro Shayzien, 'e ensures ultimate justice and safety for the entirety of Great Kourend.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Our soldiers fight off the constant threat of the lizardman, while our 'ighly trained medics 'eal them from battle. Strict in combat trainin' and discipline. Law, order and defence. These are the words we live by!

options.text: How do people start gaining favour in Shayzien?

steps.player: How do people start gaining favour in Shayzien?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Don't get us wrong, me luv', it ain't all pretty. Those who're lookin' to gain favour within this household need to 'elp in 'ealing our fallen soldiers and tackling organised crime... It's 'ard work! That bein' said...

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: The rewards for the most loyal of this 'ouse are great. The 'onour to train alongside our elite guards and wear our prestigious armour, while also fightin' on the front line against the lizardman forces. The spoils of wars are

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: grand.

options.text: Why should I gain favour in Shayzien?

steps.player: Why should I gain favour with Shayzien?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: The rewards for the most loyal of this 'ouse are great. The 'onour to train alongside our elite guards and wear our prestigious armour, while also fightin' on the front line against the lizardman forces.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: The spoils of wars are grand.
If Jennifer was not the last general store owner you talked to:
If Jennifer was the last general store owner you talked to:

steps.player: Thanks for your help, Jennifer!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: That's alright petal, you go'un and have fun.

returning-to-veos.speaker: Veos
returning-to-veos.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Where am I exactly?
Can you take me back to Port Sarim please?
Let's talk about your client...

steps.player: I have gathered information from all of the houses.
I could hear a voice, Veos... in my head! As if it whispered in my ear to return to you!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Yes, I heard it too... they mentioned that your task was complete.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Let me take those items off your hands.
Veos removes the items he gave you from your backpack.

steps.player: That reminds me, Veos! I didn't sign up to this with the knowledge that my mind would not only be entered but that there was a possibility of severely damaging my hand!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: If it makes you feel any better, my client sends their apologies. It wasn't intentional. Needless to say, something you said provoked emotion...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Namely...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: The Dark Altar...

steps.player: If I knew mentioning the Dark Altar would upset them so much, I'd have not written that bit of information down on the scroll!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Well that's just the thing, [player name]. My client is pleased you found such information. Tell me... Would you be willing to do one last thing for him?

steps.player: Well, I don't necessarily believe I have much of a choice!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I'm certainly glad you're able to assist once again.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client will be most pleased.

steps.player: So what exactly is it your client now wants me to do?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: My client requires... another simple task. He assures me that it will be the last. Take this orb. You must activate it beside the Dark Altar.
Player receives a mysterious orb.

steps.player: Can I ask why I would do that?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: It's best you don't.

steps.player: Well, can't argue with that! I'll return when I'm done!

activating-the-orb.text: Player using the "Activate" option on the mysterious orb by the Dark Altar

activating-the-orb.player: I really wish I would be warned about these things earlier...

finishing-up.speaker: Veos
finishing-up.text: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?

options.text: Where am I exactly?
Can you take me back to Port Sarim please?
Let's talk about your client...

steps.player: Veos, enough is enough! I've suffered through enough. Exploding orbs and burning quills...

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: [player name]? What are you talking about?

steps.player: You know darn well what I'm talking about!

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: [player name], I haven't spoken with you since bringing you to Zeah, I have no idea what you're on ab--

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: ARGH!

steps.player: Veos, this isn't funny anymore... Are you alright? I did all that your client asked for me...

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: You most certainly have.

steps.player: Uhm... Veos?

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: Heed my word. Your deeds will not go unthanked.

steps.player: Who are you? What have you done with Veos?

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: You care for this human? How pitiful.

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: Worry not. I'll ensure he's fine. He is of good use to me.

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: As for who I am... well. That is of no concern to you, human.
(Continued below.)

options.text: I have a right to know!

steps.player: I have a right to know!

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO KNOW NOTHING. KNOW YOUR PLACE.

options.text: (Charm) What if I asked... nicely?
options.condition: If the player is wearing a ring of Charos(a):

steps.player: What if I asked... nicely?

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: How adorable. The power of Charos? You truly thought that I could be manipulated by such feeble magic?

steps.speaker: Veos' Client
steps.text: I'll tell you what, human. Since you tried so hard - I'll tell you my name.

steps.speaker: Xeric
steps.text: Xeric.
If the client's identity is revealed, all dialogue with him here on out will be as Xeric.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.player: Why did you ask me to do all of this?

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: When the time comes, you'll know.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: Right, before I release this humans feeble mind back to consciousness... I am a man of my word. I owe you a reward.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: Tell me, [player name], after speaking to each of the houses... which activities interest you the least? I can give you a small 'boost' of favour in that house.

options.text: The Hosidius house.

steps.player: I wouldn't mind a boost within the Hosidius house...

options.text: The Arceuus house.

steps.player: I wouldn't mind a boost within the Arceuus house...

options.text: The Lovakengj house.

steps.player: I wouldn't mind a boost within the Lovakengj house...

steps.player: I wouldn't mind a boost within the Piscarilius house...

options.text: The Shayzien house.

steps.player: I wouldn't mind a boost within the Shayzien house...

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: Very well. The deed is done.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: You'll find you have gained... Up to 20% favour in [House]. They've decided to 'honour' your efforts in helping me.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: Word has spread of my return. The houses are now a little busy in their petty arguments to care about your loyalty. I imagine the speed you now gather favour within all households will be substantially faster.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.player: Wait! What if we need to speak to you again.

finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.speaker: Veos' Client
finishing-up-before-9-november-2017.text: I can continue to use this human as a conduit for communication. If you need reminding of my rewards, feel free to talk to him and I'll jump in.
